fr_html:
En 1907 on a vainement essayé de créer une Cour de Justice.

C'était toujours une Cour de Justice Arbitrale. Comment aurait-il pu en être autrement? Le lien entre les Etats manquait.
en_html: The Treaty of Peace shows that such is really the meaning of the new institution. During the present discussions the attention of the members of our Committee has been directed to various articles which refer to decision by the Court, without compromise or anything resembling it.
